caption: This drawing depicts a pale, stone-colored sculpture of a bulldog hanging over a ledge, with its front legs draped over a horizontal bar and its back legs and body hanging downward. The bulldog has a wrinkled face and an expression that is rendered with detailed shadows and highlights, giving it a realistic, three-dimensional appearance. The background and the structure supporting the bulldog are composed of warm, ochre and beige tones, with the ledge and stone surfaces creating a geometric setting. The entire scene is centered within a large area of blank, off-white space, emphasizing the subject. At the bottom of the drawing, there is a small signature or inscription written in thin, capital letters.
title: Water Spout, Sandstone
